entries.title: Mobile Diffs
entries.summary: Diffs, the review experience, is now available on iOS and Android, with guided reviews, inbox review items, preview links and merging from the phone. Several agent display fixes are also included.

entries.title: More ways to run and share Loops
entries.summary: Loops can now be started by Slack and GitHub events, saved as shareable templates, and given customized reasoning levels.
